questions.text: Walk me through a technical project you're most proud of and the decisions that made it succeed.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Clear problem framing, key technical tradeoffs, measurable impact.

questions.text: How do you approach debugging a problem you've never seen before?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Structured hypothesis testing, isolating variables, using logs/metrics.

questions.text: How do you decide when a solution is 'good enough' to ship versus needing more polish?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Risk assessment, user impact, iterative delivery mindset.

questions.text: Describe how you evaluate tradeoffs between speed of delivery and long-term quality.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Context-dependent judgment, communicating tradeoffs to stakeholders.

questions.text: How do you keep your skills current in a fast-moving field?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Concrete learning habits, applying new knowledge to real work.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you resolved a conflict with a teammate or stakeholder.
Describe a time you failed at something important. What did you learn?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Ownership without excessive self-criticism, concrete lesson applied later.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you had to work under a tight deadline with limited resources.
Describe a situation where you had to influence someone without direct authority over them.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Persuasion through evidence and relationship-building, outcome.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you received tough feedback. How did you respond?
